title: Area 51 crash: either secret US testing or intelligence watching nuclear tests

plain: A crash at Area 51, the secret test site in Nevada, sometime in the 1940s or 1950s, is explained in one of two ways: it was a secret US test, or it was some intelligence watching the nuclear tests nearby. A guest named Ralph Larson raises this with Michels, building on what Michels himself has said before. Larson admits he has not done the research or looked into it himself.
